import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.evaluator.javacode.P4OptionalExternalQualifierTest as externalBoolean;
external returning as boolean : externalBoolean(1)

import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.evaluator.javacode.P4OptionalExternalQualifierTest as externalNumber;
external returning as number : externalNumber(1)

import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.evaluator.javacode.P4OptionalExternalQualifierTest as externalString;
external returning as string : externalString(1)

import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.evaluator.javacode.P4OptionalExternalQualifierTest as externalObject;
external returning as object : externalObject(1)
var $n as number;match{true->$n as number,default->$n Float}
var $s as string;match{true->$s as string,default->$s String}
var $s as string;$s as string string part(){'x'}
match{true->$b as boolean,false->$s as string,default->$c Boolean}
var $s as string;var $n as number;match{true->$s as string,default->$n as number}
